selection: Approved P2-A01T goal and SEIT CMD-RED; supporting host tests only, no substitution for registered device demonstrations/inspections.
real_dependency: JDK17 HttpURLConnection against JDK HttpServer with an OS-bound local listener, and committed OpenAPI schemas. FixtureCalibrationTest proves actual 200 envelope and 503 structured-error transport.
fixtures: Generated at runtime from committed OpenAPI required fields, status codes and design quantities. Malformed/oversize and stale/version inputs are explicit contract negatives, not invented limits.
bootstrap_scope: Buildable Android test harness, neutral ApiClient/LinkScreen/Shell results and DTO signatures only; no feature implementation. Build minSdk and nonbehavioral manifest scaffolding are necessary preparation.
resource_group: No shared resource; each test owns OS-bound listener and executor. No devices/cloud/credential access.
reliability_plan: Run FixtureCalibrationTest five consecutive times plus two concurrent independent JVM/Gradle scratch copies; actual red behavior receipt uses all com.afc.companion.* tests.
fixture_observation: Connection observer delegates to real HttpURLConnection; actual response-code/input/output stream calls record their thread. No canned client transport response.
method_selection_skills: Test Engineering read: retain registered inspections/demonstrations, use explicit approved CMD-RED method=test for supporting implementation boundary.
reliability_result: All ten frozen test classes: 5 sequential + 2 concurrent JVMs produce identical 60/44 expected behavioral-red counts and no unexpected errors.
gate_cost: Final Gradle TV step about 5s warm, plus 1s default real backoff when implemented; fixture JVM red runs 0.338-0.380s. No hardware benchmark.
